tldr: Saturn in Libra: discipline applied to relationship, fairness, and lasting agreements.
body: With Saturn in Libra, the work is building just, committed, durable bonds. Saturn is exalted here, so structure and accountability can become unusually effective in partnership and negotiation.
gift: Principled judgment, durable partnership-building, respect for agreements, and the ability to make fairness practical.
challenge: Coldness in relationship, fear of commitment, over-duty, or using rules to avoid emotional honesty.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
